items.headline: GitLab Inc. announces global restructuring and workforce reduction while reaffirming Q1 and full-year FY27 outlook in Form 8-K
GitLab shares fall after-hours as company unveils major restructuring plan cutting about 14% of workforce and incurring $30–35 million in charges
GitLab stock volatile after-hours on AI-focused layoffs and restructuring affecting roughly 350 employees, or 14% of global workforce
